```{r, echo = FALSE, message=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning=FALSE)
# plotly.js from the CDN, so the site's pages don't each copy it
options(plotly.core.plotlyjs = "cdn")
```
#### Basic Example

Trace transforms (including `filter`) were removed from plotly.js, so filter
the data in R and plot the result.

```{r}
library(plotly.core)

cars <- mtcars[mtcars$qsec > mean(mtcars$qsec), ]

go_figure() |>
  add_scatter(
    x = cars$hp,
    y = cars$qsec,
    text = rownames(cars),
    hoverinfo = "text",
    mode = "markers"
  )
```

#### Reference

See `go_scatter()` for more information and options!
